phases.title: Phase 1 - Essential commands
phases.description: The shell as a tool: consoles and documentation, files and links, permissions, searching, text processing and regular expressions, archives, redirection, SSL certificates and Git.

weeks.title: Week 1 - Consoles, documentation, files and links
weeks.description: Getting in, finding help, and moving files around - the first week is about being at home in a shell.

lessons.title: Course introduction
lessons.summary: What the LFCS covers and how this track walks it.

lessons.title: Course structure
lessons.summary: The five domains and their weights, module by module.

lessons.title: Prerequisites, exam objectives and details
lessons.summary: What you need before starting and exactly what the exam tests.

lessons.title: LFCS command cheat sheet
lessons.summary: The reference card to keep open for the whole track.

lessons.title: Log in to local and remote graphical and text mode consoles
lessons.summary: TTYs, the display manager, and SSH - the three doors into a system.

lessons.title: Log in to consoles - part 2
lessons.summary: Switching TTYs, logging out safely, and what a session actually is.

lessons.title: Read and use system documentation
lessons.summary: man, info, --help, apropos and /usr/share/doc - answering your own questions.

lessons.title: Create, delete, copy and move files and directories
lessons.summary: touch, mkdir -p, cp -r, mv, rm -r and the globs that make them fast.

lessons.title: Create and manage hard links
lessons.summary: Inodes, link counts, and why a hard link is the same file with another name.

lessons.title: Create and manage soft links
lessons.summary: Symbolic links, relative vs absolute targets, and dangling links.

weeks.title: Week 2 - Permissions, search and text
weeks.description: Who may do what to a file, how to find files, and how to read and reshape their contents.

lessons.title: List, set and change standard file permissions
lessons.summary: rwx for user, group and other; chmod in symbolic and octal form; chown and chgrp.

lessons.title: SUID, SGID and the sticky bit
lessons.summary: The three special bits, what each does on files and directories, and how to spot them in ls.

lessons.title: Search for files
lessons.summary: find by name, size, permissions, owner, mtime - and -exec to act on the results.

lessons.title: Compare and manipulate file content
lessons.summary: cat, head, tail, diff, sort, uniq, cut, sed and tr - the text toolbox.

lessons.title: Pagers and vi
lessons.summary: less and more, then enough vi to survive: modes, save, quit, search, replace.

lessons.title: Search file content using grep
lessons.summary: grep, -i, -r, -v, -n, -c and friends.

lessons.title: Analyse text using basic regular expressions
lessons.summary: Anchors, character classes, repetition - the basic regex grammar grep speaks.

lessons.title: Extended regular expressions
lessons.summary: grep -E: alternation, grouping, {n,m} and the shortcuts.

weeks.title: Week 3 - Archives, backups and redirection
weeks.description: Packing files up, moving them elsewhere, and wiring commands together.

lessons.title: Archive, back up, compress, unpack and uncompress files
lessons.summary: tar as the archiver, and the compressors it wraps.

lessons.title: Compress and uncompress files
lessons.summary: gzip, bzip2, xz and zip - and which flags tar wants for each.

lessons.title: Back up files to a remote system
lessons.summary: rsync and scp, and why rsync -a is the habit worth having.

lessons.title: Use input-output redirection
lessons.summary: >, >>, 2>, 2>&1, <, pipes and tee - controlling where data flows.

weeks.title: Week 4 - SSL certificates and Git
weeks.description: Two tools every administrator touches weekly: openssl and git.

lessons.title: Work with SSL certificates
lessons.summary: Keys, CSRs, self-signed certificates and reading a certificate with openssl.

lessons.title: Git - basic operations
lessons.summary: init, clone, status, log - a repository from nothing.

lessons.title: Git - staging and committing changes
lessons.summary: add, commit, diff, restore - the staging area explained.

lessons.title: Git - branches and remote repositories
lessons.summary: branch, checkout, merge, push, pull - working with others.

phases.title: Phase 2 - Operations and deployment
phases.description: Running a system: boot and targets, scripting, systemd services, processes and logs, scheduling, packages, kernel parameters, SELinux, containers and virtual machines.

weeks.title: Week 5 - Boot, services, processes and logs
weeks.description: How the system comes up, how services are defined, and how to see what is running and what it says.

lessons.title: Boot, reboot and shutdown a system safely
lessons.summary: systemctl reboot/poweroff, shutdown with a delay, and warning logged-in users.

lessons.title: Boot or change the system into different operating modes
lessons.summary: systemd targets: multi-user, graphical, rescue, emergency - and setting the default.

lessons.title: Use scripting to automate system maintenance tasks
lessons.summary: Shell scripts: shebang, variables, conditionals, loops, exit codes.

lessons.title: Manage the startup process and services
lessons.summary: systemctl start/stop/enable/disable/mask, status, and reading unit dependencies.

lessons.title: Create systemd services
lessons.summary: Writing a unit file: [Unit], [Service], [Install], restart policies and daemon-reload.

lessons.title: Diagnose and manage processes
lessons.summary: ps, top, nice and renice, signals and kill, jobs, fg and bg.

lessons.title: Locate and analyse system log files
lessons.summary: journalctl and its filters, /var/log, rsyslog and logrotate.

weeks.title: Week 6 - Scheduling, packages and integrity
weeks.description: Running things on a schedule, installing software three ways, and checking the system is whole.

lessons.title: Schedule tasks to run at a set date and time
lessons.summary: cron and crontab syntax, anacron, at, and systemd timers.

lessons.title: Manage software with the package manager
lessons.summary: apt and dnf: install, remove, search, info, which package owns a file.

lessons.title: Configure the repositories of the package manager
lessons.summary: sources.list and .repo files, adding a third-party repository and its key.

lessons.title: Install software by compiling source code
lessons.summary: Build dependencies, ./configure, make, make install - and why you might not.

lessons.title: Verify integrity and availability of resources and processes
lessons.summary: df, du, free, uptime, vmstat, checking services, and fsck for filesystems.

weeks.title: Week 7 - Kernel, SELinux, containers and VMs
weeks.description: Tuning the kernel, enforcing mandatory access control, and running containers and virtual machines.

lessons.title: Change kernel runtime parameters, persistent and non-persistent
lessons.summary: sysctl, /proc/sys and /etc/sysctl.d - now and after reboot.

lessons.title: List and identify SELinux file and process contexts
lessons.summary: ls -Z, ps -Z, the user:role:type:level tuple, and getenforce.

lessons.title: Create and enforce MAC using SELinux
lessons.summary: Modes, booleans, restorecon, semanage fcontext and port labels - fixing denials properly.

lessons.title: Create and manage containers
lessons.summary: Images, containers, volumes, ports and logs with docker/podman.

lessons.title: Manage and configure virtual machines
lessons.summary: KVM, libvirt, virsh - the pieces of a Linux hypervisor.

lessons.title: Create and boot a virtual machine
lessons.summary: virt-install and cloud images, then starting, stopping and consoling into a VM.

lessons.title: Installing an operating system on a virtual machine
lessons.summary: Attaching an ISO and walking through an installer inside the VM.

phases.title: Phase 3 - Users and groups
phases.description: Accounts, groups, environment profiles, resource limits, privileges, root access and LDAP.

weeks.title: Week 8 - Users and groups
weeks.description: Accounts, groups, environment, limits, privileges and central directories.

lessons.title: Create, delete and modify local user accounts
lessons.summary: useradd, usermod, userdel, passwd, chage and the files behind them.

lessons.title: Create, delete and modify local groups and group memberships
lessons.summary: groupadd, gpasswd, usermod -aG, primary vs supplementary groups.

lessons.title: Manage system-wide environment profiles
lessons.summary: /etc/profile, /etc/profile.d, /etc/environment and login vs non-login shells.

lessons.title: Manage the template user environment
lessons.summary: /etc/skel - what every new home directory starts with.

lessons.title: Configure user resource limits
lessons.summary: ulimit and /etc/security/limits.conf - capping processes, files and memory per user.

lessons.title: Manage user privileges
lessons.summary: sudo, the sudoers file, visudo, and granting just enough.

lessons.title: Manage access to the root account
lessons.summary: su, sudo -i, locking root, and why direct root login is usually off.

lessons.title: Configure the system to use LDAP user and group accounts
lessons.summary: sssd and PAM against an LDAP directory: one identity across many hosts.

phases.title: Phase 4 - Networking
phases.description: IPv4 and IPv6, hostname resolution, network services, bridges and bonds, firewalls, NAT, reverse proxies, time sync and SSH.

weeks.title: Week 9 - Addresses, services, bridges and bonds
weeks.description: Configuring interfaces and name resolution, managing network services, and joining interfaces together.

lessons.title: Configure IPv4 and IPv6 networking and hostname resolution - theory
lessons.summary: Addresses, prefixes, gateways, DNS - what has to be true for a host to talk.

lessons.title: Configure IPv4 and IPv6 networking and hostname resolution - demo
lessons.summary: nmcli and netplan, static and DHCP, /etc/hosts and resolv.conf, hostnamectl.

lessons.title: Start, stop and check the status of network services
lessons.summary: systemctl for network daemons, ss -tulpn to see who listens.

lessons.title: Configure bridge and bonding devices - theory
lessons.summary: What a bridge is for, what a bond is for, and the bonding modes.

lessons.title: Configure bridge and bonding devices - demo
lessons.summary: Creating a bridge and a bond with nmcli and checking their state.

weeks.title: Week 10 - Firewalls, NAT, proxies, time and SSH
weeks.description: Filtering and translating traffic, fronting services, keeping time, and hardening the door you use most.

lessons.title: Configure packet filtering (firewall)
lessons.summary: firewalld zones and services, ufw, and nftables underneath.

lessons.title: Port redirection and network address translation (NAT)
lessons.summary: Masquerading, DNAT and port forwarding with firewalld and nftables.

lessons.title: Implement reverse proxies and load balancers
lessons.summary: nginx as a reverse proxy and as a load balancer over several backends.

lessons.title: Set and synchronise system time using time servers
lessons.summary: timedatectl, chrony, time zones and why clocks matter for certificates and logs.

lessons.title: Configure SSH servers and clients
lessons.summary: sshd_config hardening, key-based auth, ssh-copy-id, client config and port forwarding.

phases.title: Phase 5 - Storage
phases.description: Partitions, swap, filesystems and mount options, NFS and NBD, LVM, storage performance and advanced permissions.

weeks.title: Week 11 - Partitions, filesystems and mounts
weeks.description: From a raw disk to a mounted filesystem that comes back after a reboot.

lessons.title: List, create, delete and modify physical storage partitions
lessons.summary: lsblk, fdisk and parted, GPT vs MBR, and partition types.

lessons.title: Configure and manage swap space
lessons.summary: mkswap, swapon, swap files vs partitions, and fstab entries.

lessons.title: Create and configure file systems
lessons.summary: mkfs for ext4 and xfs, labels and UUIDs, tune2fs and xfs_admin.

lessons.title: Configure systems to mount filesystems at or during boot
lessons.summary: /etc/fstab fields, mount -a, and systemd mount units.

lessons.title: Filesystem and mount options
lessons.summary: noexec, nosuid, ro, noatime and the rest - and how to remount with them.

weeks.title: Week 12 - Network storage, LVM and advanced permissions
weeks.description: Storage that is not local, storage that can grow, and the permissions beyond rwx.

lessons.title: Use remote filesystems - NFS
lessons.summary: Exporting with /etc/exports, exportfs, mounting an NFS share, and fstab for it.

lessons.title: Use network block devices - NBD
lessons.summary: nbd-server and nbd-client: a block device over the network, and when that beats NFS.

lessons.title: Manage and configure LVM storage
lessons.summary: PV, VG, LV; creating, extending and reducing; resizing the filesystem with it.

lessons.title: Monitor storage performance
lessons.summary: iostat, iotop, vmstat and reading what the numbers mean.

lessons.title: Create, manage and diagnose advanced filesystem permissions
lessons.summary: ACLs with getfacl and setfacl, default ACLs, and file attributes with chattr.

phases.description: Four mock exams under time pressure, and the course conclusion.

weeks.description: Four timed mock exams, then the course conclusion.

lessons.title: Mock exams - how to use them
lessons.summary: Time yourself, mark honestly, and turn every wrong answer into a lab.

lessons.title: LFCS mock exam 1
lessons.summary: A full timed mock across all five domains.

lessons.title: LFCS mock exam 2
lessons.summary: A second full timed mock.

lessons.title: LFCS mock exam 3
lessons.summary: A third full timed mock.

lessons.title: LFCS mock exam 4
lessons.summary: The last mock before the real thing.

lessons.title: Conclusion
lessons.summary: Booking the exam and what to do in the final week.
